3308.text: Page 63 • Visiting Appointment: Involves a definite term contract of up to two years, including a probation year. Renewal for the second year is subject to department needs and successful annual evaluations as per UoS policies. In exceptional cases, and with Chancellor approval, the visiting contract may be extended for an additional year. Visiting faculty members contribute to teaching, research, and service during their appointment. • Lecturers/Senior Lecturers/Instructors and Senior Instructors: Appointed on a definite contract for two years, including a probation year. The contract is renewable every two years based on satisfactory performance as per UoS policies. 2.4 Probation and Resignation Notice • The faculty probation period is one year, extendable to a maximum of two years under exceptional circumstances with Chancellor approval. Termination during the probation period requires a recommendation by the relevant academic administrators and approval from the Dean, Vice Chancellor, and Chancellor. Faculty members intending to resign during probation must provide a six-month notice.

3310.text: in a 50% deduction from the end of service compensation unless exceptions are granted by the Chancellor. New faculty members who are terminated during probation are entitled to return tickets, while new faculty members who resign during probation are not entitled to benefits such as annual leave and ticket allowances. 2.5 Confirmation • At the end of the first year of the contract, the performance of new faculty members is evaluated by the department chair, dean, central hiring and evaluation committee, and student evaluations. The evaluation results determine whether the faculty member’s contract is renewed, probation is extended, or contract renewal occurs with specific teaching and research terms. • New faculty members must receive written notification of employment confirmation or termination six months before the end of the contract. If neither occurs, the new faculty member’s employment is considered confirmed. Employment confirmation includes the probation period when calculating the employee’s End of Service Benefit.

4341.text: their core responsibilities, faculty members at the University of Sharjah are expected to actively participate in professional development activities that support excellence in teaching, research, and service. These activities are provided at both the departmental and university-wide levels and are designed to align with institutional goals and individual academic growth. Faculty are responsible for engaging in the following development activities: • Department-Level Development o Collaborate with department chairs to identify and address individual development needs. o Utilize available resources such as travel funding, reassigned time, and mentoring support. o Participate in department-led initiatives and internal professional development sessions. • University-Level Development Programs o Participate in cross-disciplinary faculty development programs offered by the University. o Engage in university-wide workshops and seminars focused on improving teaching, research, and service effectiveness. • New Faculty Development Training (via ILHE) o Attend orientation and training programs covering pedagogy, technology, research skills, and institutional policies.

5738.text: Page 107 4.3 Leaves and Absences 4.3.1 Vacation Leave • Vacation days are provided as per the Faculty and Staff Pay Grade and Benefits Chart, including summer vacation, religious and national holidays, and other specified vacations in the academic calendar. • During mid-semester and final exams, faculty involved in the exam process are expected to conduct exams, even during weekends and regular holidays. 4.3.2 Sick Leave • Faculty are entitled to sick leave with full pay for up to 15 working days and half pay for an additional 15 working days per contract year. This applies to personal illness or attendance upon an ill immediate family member, either in or out of the UAE. • If all sick leave days have been utilized, annual vacation leave may be used. In special circumstances, up to an additional 30 days of sick leave without pay may be granted.

14468.text: 1 IThenticate Guidelines IThenticate is a text-matching tool that is designed to be used by authors to ensure the originality of written work. IThenticate is used for university researchers to enrich the researches and check the plagiarism. How to access IThenticate 1) Open www.ithenticate.com 2) Click on login 3) Type your university email and your password (activation password is sent to you through ithenticate.com ) If you are unable to access iThenticate software email: servicedesk@sharjah.ac.ae How to upload a document 1) Select the “Upload a File” link under the “Submit a Document” section on the home screen 2) Enter in the author’s name and the document title, then click the “Choose a File” button in order to open your file 3) Once you have opened your file, click “Upload” to upload your file 4) If you will upload the same document but with an updated version use the following button and upload the updated document Note: The analysis may take a few hours Checking Similarity Report  The similarity index and originality report can be found under the “Documents”  You need to click on report percentage shown to be able to view the similarity report  You will be able to view the resources as shown below  You can discard some resources by clicking on “Exclude resource”  The user has a multiple settings and filtering options to deal with documents File Requirements:  Each instructor is limited to a specific amount of submission (Maximum 30 Documents per year)  Use “Upload a New Revision” instead of “upload file” for every time you update the same research paper (this will not be counted as extra doc.)  Files must be less than 100MB.
